$schema-title: T21 audit-gate exceptions. The fr gate runs `--scope prod` (level high): production dependencies must always audit clean. Dev-dependency advisories that gate cannot see are recorded here so nothing is waived silently — accepted, owned, time-boxed. Re-check on review-by: when `pnpm audit` (full) stops listing an advisory, prune the entry.

exceptions.reason: devDependency-only, via @lhci/cli -> lighthouse -> puppeteer-core -> proxy-agent chain; the module never reaches a browser or the deployed app. Fix (basic-ftp 6.2.1) is incompatible with the pinned proxy-agent line.

devDependency-only, used by the browser-install toolchain (playwright/puppeteer) to unpack downloaded browser archives. Upstream states NO patched release at any version; accepted until the toolchain swaps the library.
Same toolchain path and upstream status as GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3 — no patched release exists; dev machines/CI download browsers from pinned playwright registries only.
devDependency-only (browser-install toolchain, also reachable via the @lhci CLI). tmp 0.2.6 would break the pinned toolchains that expect the 0.0.x API.

The APP's zod is pinned >= 4.6.6 (fixed). A second, transitive zod@3.25.76 remains under the shadcn CLI and the lighthouse chain — dev-only, never bundled; upgrading those to zod 4 is upstream work this repo can only wait for.
devDependency-only (@lhci chain). No compatible fix published in the 4.x line the toolchain requires.
devDependency-only (browser-install toolchain); same constraint as GHSA-ph9p-34f9-6g65 — the 0.0.x API is what the toolchains pin.
